subject: Request: short extension / sandbox burst for competitive bake-off
messages:
From: Claire Young <claire.young@healthlytics.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: short extension / sandbox burst for competitive bake-off

Diego —

Quick note from our side: we have a confirmation for a head-to-head bake-off next week (HealthLytics vs. StreamlineAI) and we need another 72-hour sandbox burst plus access to longer context runs to validate latency and reranking under load. The team loved Redwood in the initial sandbox but we ran out of credits before we could finish the scoring runs.

Questions: can you (a) extend the trial window by 14 days, and (b) provide a temporary bump (~3k eval credits / 25k tokens) with streaming enabled so we can run our automated eval harness? Procurement wants to see the proposed scope and any T&Cs.

We need a decision by Tue EOD to keep Redwood in the bake-off. Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

— Claire
Claire Young
Director, AI Evaluation 
HealthLytics

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Claire Young <claire.young@healthlytics.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: short extension / sandbox burst for competitive bake-off

Claire — thanks for the heads-up, and congrats on getting the slot. We can make this work.

Proposal (quick):
- 14 day trial extension from Monday 6/29
- One-time eval top-up: 3,000 eval credits (~25k tokens)
- Streaming enabled; extended context to 8k tokens for the sandbox runs

I attached a short manifest outlining the sandbox limits and the temporary token cap (sandbox_quota_manifest.csv) and our eval terms (redwood_eval_terms_v1.pdf). If procurement needs PO language, ping procurement@healthlytics.com and loop me.

Two asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the account team (procurement contact) so we can route the DocuSign and invoice exception.
2) Provide the priority test window (exact dates) so we pin capacity.

If that looks good I’ll route the credit approval internally (Ben will need to OK the credit allotment) and loop in Compliance to ensure usage is logged for benchmarking fairness.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sandbox_quota_manifest.csv (CSV, 1KB), redwood_eval_terms_v1.pdf (PDF, 28KB)
